firstPage.summary: Azure Reach opens as immaculate public magic while Sea Turtle Thursdays branding immediately creates guest confusion; Pip begins translating the promise without puncturing the experience.
panelPlan: 1. Splash-width exterior: Azure Reach entrance, architectural glass, water features, families, influencers, sponsor signage; giant banner reads SEA TURTLE THURSDAYS / PRESENTED BY PELAGIC PURE WATER.
2. Guest insert: turtle-hoodie kid points at the banner; parent answers.
3. Pip works guest flow with tablet as three guests ask incompatible questions.
4. Pip close-up: customer-service smile holds while she clarifies no touching, release, or literal special access.
5. Pip radios the naming complaint while guest flow continues behind her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: Out front, Azure Reach looks effortless.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kid
dialogueInline.text: Is Thursday the turtle?

dialogueInline.speaker: Parent
dialogueInline.text: I think Thursday is the experience.

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest 1
dialogueInline.text: Do we touch turtles?

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest 2
dialogueInline.text: Is there a release?

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest 3
dialogueInline.text: Our VIP pass says enhanced access.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: No touching, no public release, and “enhanced access” means you get confused closer to the sign.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: Guest Relations to whoever named this. Sea Turtle Thursdays is already doing a lot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur
dialogueInline.text: It has bounce.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: Bounce is not usually what we want near turtles.

directionInline.text: AZURE REACH VISUAL LANGUAGE: Large, glossy, popular, well-funded modern marine park; bright glass-and-water spectacle over clean backstage competence. Workplace warmth under pressure. Animals are serene, safe, loved, and never the joke. Human misunderstanding and conflicting professional priorities drive the comedy.

PAGE ACTION — SOURCE-LOCKED: Azure Reach opens as immaculate public magic while Sea Turtle Thursdays branding immediately creates guest confusion; Pip begins translating the promise without puncturing the experience.

CHARACTER CONTINUITY — Maya stays dark navy technical Brine Squad: radio/utility gear, practical dark hair, guarded posture, no hot pink; never resemble Pip. Pip stays lighter blue/teal Guest Relations: tablet/headset/badge, warm animated posture; never resemble Maya. Fleur stays elegant camera-ready azure with stronger hot-pink Finfluencer accents, poised and visually exacting.

LOCATION / PROP / STATE CONTINUITY — Opening morning. SEA TURTLE THURSDAYS / PRESENTED BY PELAGIC PURE WATER banner is the dominant public prop. Crowd density feels popular and controlled, not dangerous.

COMIC PAGE / LETTERING — 5 panels. Page feel: Bright, expensive, busy, funny before backstage. Key image: Huge SEA TURTLE THURSDAYS banner over the gorgeous public entrance. Compose with intentional negative space for balloons/captions before lettering. Use clean professional integrated comic lettering, preserve exact dialogue/signage, keep balloon reading order unambiguous, and do not duplicate text.

sampleIssue2Page1.summary: A dolphin returns a guest’s dropped phone to the habitat ledge, and one sincere misunderstanding instantly becomes public mythology.
panelPlan: 1. Wide public-magic opener: dolphins arc through a luminous blue habitat while a phone slips onto a protected dry-side catch ledge.
2. A dolphin nudges the phone toward the keeper return point; Maya and Sal notice from staff side.
3. Pip returns the intact phone to its owner.
4. The owner is overwhelmed and posts that the dolphin chose her.
5. Nearby guests look at their own belongings with dangerous inspiration.

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest
dialogueInline.text: She brought it back to me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: Our staff recovered it from the return ledge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest
dialogueInline.text: After she brought it back to me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: That sentence is going to cost us.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sal
dialogueInline.text: Already has.

sampleIssue3Page1.summary: Beatrice unveils the VIP Tidepool Experience as forty minutes of private, unhurried access, and Maya immediately notices that the promise lasts longer than the animal-care window.
panelPlan: 1. Wide sponsor-facing presentation: a polished deck reads VIP TIDEPOOL EXPERIENCE — PRIVATE. UNHURRIED. YOUR OCEAN.
2. Beatrice advances to a forty-minute premium-session timeline.
3. Maya compares it with the care schedule on her tablet.
4. Dora quietly marks the twelve-minute animal-contact window and reset period.
5. Pip realizes the public promise and care schedule describe two different products.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: Forty minutes. One habitat. One expert. No rush.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian
dialogueInline.text: It should feel like the park has stopped for them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: The habitat does not stop for them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dora
dialogueInline.text: Twelve minutes at the wet edge. Then the animals rotate and the zone resets.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: So we sold forty minutes of a twelve-minute thing.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: We sold forty minutes of access. Make the distinction invisible.

lastPage.summary: At the staff overlook after the gala, Maya and Sal watch the still-beautiful park return to ordinary night operations and recognize that the best outcome is that nobody saw how much coordination it took.
panelPlan: 1. Quiet final splash-like wide panel across the glowing marine park after the gala; bright blues and cyan reflections, no muddy night palette.
2. Maya and Sal sit at the overlook with the gala lights mostly off.
3. In the distance, ordinary staff carts and habitat lights continue on schedule.
4. Maya checks one final message: GALA COMPLETE / OPERATIONS NORMAL.
5. Sal looks at the public side, now empty and pristine.
6. Final close two-shot, understated rather than triumphant.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: Nobody saw half of what it took to make that work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sal
dialogueInline.text: Good.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: Good?

dialogueInline.speaker: Sal
dialogueInline.text: That means it worked.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: Make it invisible.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sal
dialogueInline.text: Apparently.
